_about: Tuning numbers for The Word Play. Change these freely; no code changes needed. Times are in seconds.
_caseLineRows: How many rows sit above the DO NOT CROSS tape in each mode. Bigger number = lower tape = less room.
tips: Detectives look for vowels. Drop A, E, I, O or U between two letters to crack a word.
Keep the middle low. Spread your letters across the whole board.
Short words count too. AT, IT and UP can save the case.
Switch a letter while it falls. Once it lands, it is locked.
Stuck? Tap Clue and follow the note.
